title: 第3章 成亲赌约典当肉身第4章 得草寒瑛月魄
content_zh:
何为藩，藩地也！
鉴天教乃是仙教大宗，故而道统之中有一理念——仙道贵生。
山门之中的诸多异族精怪，亦是天地生养，所以不会随意滥杀，而是划分了诸多地界，让众多异族精怪自由生活其间，得享安宁。
当然，一切还是要受仙教管辖。
所以每隔千年都会由仙教敕令，任命藩主，除去藩主之外，藩地一切事物仙教都不再理会，只要藩内按时上交相应的“灵税”即可。
藩内生灵，等同仙教门人，就算是仙教真传弟子，都不可随意杀害，否则教规无情。
这样的藩地，在鉴天教中共有一十二座，这赤松藩乃是距离玉庭山最近的一处。
只见界碑之后，乃是一座陡峭之峡谷，两侧山崖如天幕垂直，飞鸟难越，唯有此前的谷道可过。
就在陆玄遥看妖藩之时，峡谷之前，有浑厚的质问声响起：
“什么人前来赤松藩，可有玉碟文书？！”
陆玄抬头，只见界碑之后，两尊身高数丈，浑身恍若岩石铸就，犀头人身的妖怪正看着自己。
观其气息，比自己浑厚不止一筹，周身有一团如山岩厚重的气息浮动。
炼炁犀妖。
但陆玄并未害怕，只是轻轻抬起腰间的玉符，对着两妖说道：“【蛰院】弟子，前来游览赤松。”
“蛰院弟子？”
那犀妖碧绿色的眼眸看向陆玄，露出了一丝诧异之色，但看向其腰间的玉符，终究还是未曾阻拦，只是说道：
“游览至多七日，否则失了玉符，陷在藩中，恐有祸事。”
“还有，藩中不在【小青霓云】驱使范围之内，你若想去的远些，藩中有灵鹤可雇，但黑羽的莫雇。”
“胎息境，攒些灵石不易。”
赤松藩和玉庭山相距不远，故而藩中精怪对【蛰院】弟子也并不陌生，犀妖一看陆玄此时还佩戴蛰院玉符，但却并未炼炁成功，就知晓了一切。

但蛰院弟子还有金甲玉躯之法可修，所以他好心提醒了两句，算是结个善缘。
“多谢犀士。”
陆玄拜谢一声，随即犀妖挥手，让开了道路。
“咻！”
但就在这时，天穹之上，又有一团青光落下，降在峡谷之前。
陆玄抬首看去，见到了一个熟悉的身影。
那道身影也见到了陆玄，当即露出了诧异之色：“陆师弟……”
“林师兄”
陆玄转身，行了一礼。
眼前之人亦是【蛰院】弟子，且和他一般，都是采炁大醮的失败者。
“陆师弟，你缘何在此？”
看着眼前身量极高，岩岩若孤松独立的陆玄，林师兄眼神一眯，似乎想到了什么，忍不住问道。
“静极思动，游走一番。”
陆玄看着身穿崭新法袍，脚踏新云靴的林师兄，心中也有了一个猜测，当即只是淡淡的答道。
“那就祝师弟好运了。”
林师兄没想到在这里能遇见“同道中人”……但这毕竟不是什么光彩的事，当即大步向前，超越陆玄，先一步踏进峡谷，不见了踪影。
犀妖见状，也并未阻拦。
陆玄则也是有意放缓了脚步，拉开了和林师兄的距离，后一步走入峡谷，入了赤松藩内。
……
……

走出峡谷，霎时间，灵气翻涌，灵鹤齐鸣，无数野兽、人声喧嚣而起，一片繁闹之景。
content_en:
What is a vassal state? A vassal land!
The Jiantian Sect is the main sect of the Immortal Sect, so there is a concept in the Taoism - the Immortal Way and Preserving Life.
The many alien spirits and monsters in the mountain gate are also born and raised by heaven and earth, so they will not kill them at will. Instead, they have divided many boundaries to allow many alien spirits to live freely and enjoy peace.
Of course, everything still has to be governed by the Immortal Religion.
Therefore, every thousand years, the Immortal Cult would issue an order to appoint a feudal lord. Apart from the feudal lord, the Immortal Cult would no longer care about anything in the domain, as long as the feudal lord paid the corresponding "spiritual tax" on time.
All living beings in the vassal are equivalent to disciples of the Immortal Sect. Even if they are true disciples of the Immortal Sect, they are not allowed to kill at will, otherwise the rules will be ruthless.
There are a total of twelve such vassals in the Jiantian Sect, and the Chisong Domain is the one closest to Yuting Mountain.
After the boundary monument, there is a steep canyon. The cliffs on both sides are as vertical as the sky. It is difficult for birds to cross. Only the previous valley road can pass.
Just when Lu Xuanyao was looking at Yao Fan, a strong voice of questioning sounded in front of the canyon:
"Who comes to Chisong Domain and has a jade plate document?!"
Lu Xuan looked up and saw behind the boundary monument, two monsters several feet tall, as if they were made of rock, with rhinoceros heads and human bodies looking at him.
Looking at his aura, it was much thicker than his own, and there was a mass of aura floating around him that was as thick as a mountain rock.
Refining the rhinoceros monster.
But Lu Xuan was not afraid. He just gently raised the jade talisman on his waist and said to the two demons: "Disciples of [Zheyuan], come and visit Chisong."
"Disciple of Zheyuan?"
The rhinoceros demon's green eyes looked at Lu Xuan with a hint of surprise, but when he looked at the jade talisman on his waist, he did not stop him and just said:
"You can only visit for seven days at most, otherwise you will lose the jade talisman and get trapped in the feudal lord, which may cause disaster."
"Also, the vassal is not within the driving range of [Little Qingniyun]. If you want to go further, there are spiritual cranes available for hire in the vassal, but don't hire black feathers."
"In the fetal breath realm, it's not easy to accumulate some spiritual stones."
Chisong Domain and Yuting Mountain are not far apart, so the spirits in the domain are no strangers to the disciples of the Hiding Academy. The rhinoceros monster knew everything when he saw that Lu Xuan was still wearing the Jade Talisman of Hiding Court, but had not succeeded in refining Qi.
But the disciples of Zheyuan still have the golden armor and jade body method to practice, so he kindly reminded him a few words, which was regarded as a good relationship.
"Thank you Rhino."
Lu Xuan thanked him, and then the rhinoceros demon waved his hand and moved out of the way.
"Phew!"
But at this moment, another group of green light fell from the sky and landed in front of the canyon.
Lu Xuan looked up and saw a familiar figure.
The figure also saw Lu Xuan, and immediately showed a look of surprise: "Junior Brother Lu..."
"Senior Brother Lin"
Lu Xuan turned around and saluted.
The person in front of me is also a disciple of [Zheyuan], and like him, he is a loser in the Qi Qi Dajiao.
"Junior Brother Lu, why are you here?"
Looking at the extremely tall Lu Xuan in front of him, who looked as independent as a lone pine in the rocks, Senior Brother Lin narrowed his eyes and seemed to have thought of something, so he couldn't help but ask.
"Quiet and restless, take a walk."
Lu Xuan looked at Senior Brother Lin who was wearing a brand new robe and new cloud boots, and he had a guess in his mind, and he just replied lightly.
"Then I wish you good luck, junior brother."
Senior Brother Lin didn't expect to meet "people of the same kind" here... But it was not a glorious thing after all. He immediately strode forward, surpassed Lu Xuan, stepped into the canyon first, and disappeared.
When the rhinoceros demon saw this, he did not stop him.
Lu Xuanze also deliberately slowed down his pace, widened the distance between him and Senior Brother Lin, and then took a step into the canyon and entered the Chisong Domain.
…
…
Walking out of the canyon, in an instant, spiritual energy surged, spiritual cranes roared, countless wild beasts and human voices rose up, creating a bustling scene.
